Source: `documents/cv/example-resume.pdf` (repository-relative placeholder; replace with a user-supplied source before use).

This is an illustrative public template. Replace placeholders only with facts the candidate confirms.

- **Name:** Example Candidate
- **Location:** Example City, Example Country
- **Phone:** `<phone-number>`
- **Email:** candidate@example.test
- **LinkedIn:** https://linkedin.example/candidate
- **GitHub:** https://github.example/candidate
- **Languages:** Confirm with candidate

## Professional Experience

Use one entry per confirmed role. Do not infer employers, dates, responsibilities, or metrics.

### [Most recent role] - Example Company ([YYYY]-Present)
- [Verified responsibility or measurable outcome]
- [Second verified responsibility or outcome]
- **Tech:** [confirmed technologies]

### [Previous role] - Previous Example Company ([YYYY]-[YYYY])
- [Verified responsibility or measurable outcome]
- [Second verified responsibility or outcome]

## Independent Projects
- Record only projects the candidate confirms, with a short factual description.

## Technical Skills

Use only skills confirmed by the candidate. The following are illustrative categories, not claims about a real person.

### Backend & Architecture
- Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Node.js, REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture

### Data & Messaging
- PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, indexing, schema design

### Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps
- Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, observability, cloud platforms

### Frontend & Other
- React, TypeScript, Python, C++, or other confirmed tools

## Publications
- Add only confirmed publications; otherwise write `None listed`.

## Awards
- Add only confirmed awards; otherwise write `None listed`.

## Certifications
- Add only confirmed certifications with issuer and date.

## References
- Do not include private contact details. Write `Available upon request` when appropriate.

## Public-use rule
- Keep this file generic in public repositories. Store real profile facts in the local runtime profile, which is gitignored.
